when: The next step on the main path; also the continuation onto the next row when a long main path wraps
target_placement: Same row and the next column (first column of the next row for a wrap)
notes: Rows aligned on box middles keep these lines straight

when: An outcome that returns to an earlier step: rework; retry; correction
target_placement: Target is earlier in the sequence
notes: Takes the top even on a decision box; the other outcomes then skip the top (L04)

when: First outcome of a decision box: the expected or most common outcome
target_placement: Same row and the next column

when: Second outcome of a decision box when no loop back has taken the top
target_placement: Row above and the next column; the cell directly above the decision box stays empty
notes: A journey drop-off is usually this outcome

when: Third outcome of a decision box; or the second when a loop back has taken the top
target_placement: Row below and the next column; the cell directly below the decision box stays empty

when: Fourth and later outcomes of a decision box
from_side: the side of right/top/bottom facing the target
upn_meaning: Two lines leaving one point read in UPN as parallel paths
notes: Warn that a decision with more than three outcomes is worth splitting; an end marker on a reused side lands on the other line's path

when: An alternative path coming back into the main path at a later box from a lower row
target_placement: Target is later in the main row
upn_meaning: Either path starts the step (it enters at a different point from the main path)

when: An alternative path coming back into the main path at a later box from an upper row
target_placement: Target is later in the main row
notes: Do not combine with a loop back into the same box: both would enter its top middle

when: One outcome that starts two or more steps at the same time
target_placement: Targets stacked in the next column
notes: The lines share their first segment and their identical labels overlap

when: A step that may start only when every incoming path has finished
A line from a start marker or a free start into the first box of a level; on a child level the inputs seeded by add child
target_placement: The free end sits 240 px left of the box (free_end_length); the server chooses a clear side and may shorten the requested stub; check returned layout
notes: Keep its label short and check its returned route

when: A line from the last box to an end marker; a free end or a hand-over; on a child level the outputs seeded by add child
target_placement: The free end sits 240 px right of the box (free_end_length); the server chooses a clear side and may shorten the requested stub; check returned layout
notes: Keep its label short and check its returned route

when: An outcome that ends the work early (opportunity closed lost) or a customer leaving a journey
from_side: per the decision order (L04 to L06)
target_placement: The end marker sits 240 px beyond a left or right side or 120 px beyond a top or bottom (free_end_length); the server chooses a clear side and may shorten the requested stub; check returned layout
